name: How does engineering coordination impact the cost of my luxury home project?

mainEntity.name: How does engineering coordination impact the cost of my luxury home project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Effective engineering coordination can significantly reduce overall project costs by preventing expensive rework, change orders, and schedule delays caused by design conflicts or unforeseen issues. While there's an initial investment in coordination services, it often leads to long-term savings through optimized material use, efficient construction sequencing, and avoidance of potential structural or system failures. It ensures a smoother project timeline and budget adherence.
acceptedAnswer.description: Effective engineering coordination reduces overall project costs by preventing rework and delays, leading to long-term savings and smoother project timelines.
